about: VFX-LAB-2+3 · the card registry. A card manifests only if it has an entry here (and is a Hero or Unit, A2). ladderExempt: true takes the card off the rarity duration ladder — ruling A3 grants that to the pilot alone. LAB-4d · defaults: the tuning every card inherits unless it carries its own — tempo (a card's manifest may set its own) and fizzle_ms (a faction's exit preset may set its own). Owner ruling 2026-09-13: 0.6× and 1500 ms. LAB-6: a card entry may also name itself (name, type, rarity, faction) and its exit ('faction' = its faction's preset in data/factionfx.json) — documentation only; a play reads type, rarity and faction from the board. LAB-7: every entry is keyed by the card's ENGINE id; "fixture" names its fixtures (fixtures/<fixture>_seat0/1.json) and "art" its card frame (copied into art/ by tools/copy_runtime.js) — the lab page builds its Play buttons and board art from these. LAB-8: "exit": "native" plays the clip's own exit — no FIZZLE, no procedural dissolve — when the manifest is a native-exit pack (ActorManifest.exitMode); any other value ("faction", absent) keeps the procedural faction dissolve. "label" is the Play button's text. LAB-9: a card whose action is a self-cast softens its contact with the manifest's contactStrength.

indra.name: Indra
indra.ruling: LAB-6 — the second character, built by the template; LAB-10: the clip's own gold-dust ending restored, so he exits natively and performs where he stands (travelScale 0); tempo inherited

hanuman.name: Bali
hanuman.ruling: LAB-7 — the third character, built by the template; the engine's id for Bali is "hanuman" (the card was renamed, its id was not), so the registry keys him by that id; LAB-10: his earth exit restored (ended at f109, before the clip's green blob), so he exits natively and performs where he stands (travelScale 0)

mahabali.name: Mahabali

mahabali.ruling: LAB-9 — a launch character by the template: the throne is part of the actor; nova contact on the engulfment (f096), native exit, bottom-edge feather over the fire pool

shukra.name: Shukracharya
shukra.label: Shukracharya (Asura Hero, Epic)
shukra.ruling: LAB-9 — a launch character by the template; the engine id is "shukra" (the folder and fixture stay "shukracharya"). A SELF-CAST: nova contact at the cast (f064) softened by contactStrength (half flash, no impulse), native exit

mahishi.name: Mahishi
mahishi.label: Mahishi (Asura Hero, Legendary)
mahishi.ruling: LAB-11 - a Wave-1 hero reached by NAME through the scenario deck, no shim: the draft filter runs on the random pool, CARD_BY_NAME is built from every deck. The idle f000-f032 is dropped (no idle padding: AWAKEN is the anticipation beat); ACT opens on f056, the frame the fire arc goes radial, so the nova bursts where the ring is born rather than where it is brightest. Stopped at f115: past it her red powder is gone and only khaki ground residue is left. Bottom feather 12 px, guarded on the settled frame f036 (core gap 16 px). Engine power P5 via R64 then R76

vritra.name: Vritra
vritra.label: Vritra (Asura Hero, Legendary)
vritra.ruling: LAB-11 - a Wave-1 hero reached by NAME through the scenario deck, no shim (see mahishi). A coiled serpent has no feet: "feet" resolves to the COIL BASE, the ground line under the coil, measured once on the settled frame f000 at source (962.8, 1057) - the serpent reading of the rule, alongside Mahabali's throne base; because the pack measures one pivot on one settled frame and reuses it, the pivot cannot drift through the rear-up. ACT opens on f072, the top of the rear: the roar IS the strike, so the nova is the shockwave; the f090 fire is his exit, not his attack. Stopped at f112: past it the drifting chunks carry pale ground halos and Kling smoke despills to magenta, and the magenta that remains (f107-f110) plays inside the back half of the fade ramp. Bottom feather 16 px, guarded on f000 (core gap 24 px). Engine power P6 via R65 then R80

garuda.name: Garuda
garuda.label: Garuda (Deva Hero, Legendary)
garuda.ruling: LAB-12 - a Wave-1 hero reached by NAME through the scenario deck, no shim (the LAB-11 finding). A PERMANENT HOVERER: "feet" resolves to his TALON TIPS, found by the existing feet rule on the settled frame f000 at source (944, 1063), so his talons sit on the card ground line and the hover reads from the clip own lift (his talon line rises about 100 source px across the play). f000 is the ONLY safe settled frame: from f002 his robe sash hangs lower than the talons, and from about f045 shed feathers drift below him. ACT opens on f040, the wing snap, with the nova on f041 - the burst birth, not the f062 brightness peak. Only the empty frames f117-f120 are dropped; his gold-dust tail is clean. ACCEPTED DEFECT: his wings cross the TOP frame edge in 42 frames and the cut is accepted - a guarded top feather is unsatisfiable because his core sits on row 0 in 40 of them. cellPx 448 on the A5 ruling: 10.8 MB on the 256 rung against 15.5 MB at 512. Engine power P7, untouched by the balance campaign

kartikeya.name: Kartikeya
kartikeya.label: Kartikeya (Deva Hero, Legendary)
kartikeya.ruling: LAB-13 - a Wave-1 hero reached by NAME through the scenario deck, no shim (the LAB-11 finding). THE FIRST MAGENTA GROUND: magenta is a TWO-CHANNEL key (R and B together oppose G), and the single-channel rule argmax gives INVERTS him - on (243, 6, 240) it reads R - max(G, B) = 3, so the ground tests as less key-coloured than the figure and the matte keeps the screen and cuts the man out. The pack now classifies the ground and keys on the pair: level = min(R, B) against G, and the despill subtracts the pair excess from BOTH key channels, which leaves his gold, his white and the peacock blue-green untouched. He THROWS: ACT opens on the hurl (f045) and the contact is the bolt-edge frame f050, where the lance reaches the frame edge. Stopped at f102: past it his translucent dissolve un-mixes to pink ground residue, so the fade tail carries him out instead. Standard feet pivot on the settled frame f000 at (960.9, 1055) - he stands beside the peacock, he does not ride it. ACCEPTED: the lance leaves the frame right edge f049-f055 (the attack reading correctly) and his banner grazes the top f028-f034. LAB-13a: travelScale 0 - he is bolt-edge, not nova, so the nova zero-travel special case never covered him and LAB-13 never set the data line; he shipped charging 31 px at the player seat and 57 px at the top seat. bolt-edge says where the contact lands, not whether the actor moves. cellPx 384 rather than the 448 first ruled: at 448 his 256 rung packs to 27.3 percent of the 512 rung and breaks the A5 quarter-rung invariant, while 384 packs to 25.4 percent and costs 8.0 MB on the low rung, the least of any card. Engine power P8, untouched by the balance campaign

vasuki.name: Vasuki
vasuki.label: Vasuki (Naga Hero, Legendary)
vasuki.ruling: LAB-14 - one of the FIRST NAGA actors. Identity was verified against the staged master before packing: the STEP-0 gate caught a THREE-WAY rotation among takshaka, vasuki and kulika (each clip matched a different master at about 0.99 while matching its own name at 0.71-0.76), and the owner re-staged before anything was packed - the master is the provenance parent, the filename is not authority. He sits on a coil, so the feet rule resolves to the COIL BASE (the Vritra reading). Native exit, so the Naga dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised. His ring pulse is born at f045 and the nova rides that birth, not its f060 peak. NOTHING IS TRIMMED: his closing teal cloud is genuine matter, not ground residue (despilled mean 120/165/197, ground-dominant share holds 5.9-13.4 percent and never climbs), but the clip does not end empty - 362k px still stand at f120 - so the fade tail does real work, the Vritra case. No bottom feather: he never touches the bottom edge. Engine power P8, a launch card untouched by the balance campaign

takshaka.name: Takshaka
takshaka.label: Takshaka (Naga Hero, Epic)
takshaka.ruling: LAB-14 - one of the FIRST NAGA actors. Identity was verified against the staged master before packing: the STEP-0 gate caught a THREE-WAY rotation among takshaka, vasuki and kulika (each clip matched a different master at about 0.99 while matching its own name at 0.71-0.76), and the owner re-staged before anything was packed - the master is the provenance parent, the filename is not authority. He sits on a coil, so the feet rule resolves to the COIL BASE (the Vritra reading). Native exit, so the Naga dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised. He conjures the orb at f040 and the arcs sweep out; the nova sits on f056, the largest picture change in the clip. Stopped at f110: past it his specks are increasingly GROUND rather than debris (19.4 percent at f110 climbing to 65 percent at f120, the despilled mean going near-black) - the Kartikeya pink-residue class. Bottom feather 16 px, guarded by the LAB-13 ALL-FRAMES rule at a 35 px core gap measured across all 54 EMERGE frames. Engine power P6, a launch card untouched by the balance campaign

shesha.name: Shesha
shesha.label: Shesha (Naga Hero, Legendary)
shesha.ruling: LAB-14 - one of the FIRST NAGA actors. Identity was verified against the staged master before packing: the STEP-0 gate caught a THREE-WAY rotation among takshaka, vasuki and kulika (each clip matched a different master at about 0.99 while matching its own name at 0.71-0.76), and the owner re-staged before anything was packed - the master is the provenance parent, the filename is not authority. He sits on a coil, so the feet rule resolves to the COIL BASE (the Vritra reading). Native exit, so the Naga dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised. A SOFT CAST, and the measurement says so: nothing in his clip strikes. His picture change holds flat at 3.5-3.9 through the whole build and his brightness climbs gently then PLATEAUS - there is no percussive moment anywhere. So the nova rides the radiance at its fullest (f078, 38.2k) rather than an arbitrary point on the ramp or the f094 dissolve flash that is his exit, and contactStrength softens it exactly as Shukracharya does (half flash, no impulse). The late ACT cell index is harmless because a nova performs where it stands. Stopped at f113: he nearly finishes himself, empty from f116. Engine power P7, a launch card untouched by the balance campaign

padmavati.name: Padmavati
padmavati.label: Padmavati (Naga Hero, Legendary)
padmavati.ruling: LAB-15 - a Wave-1 NAGA hero. Identity re-verified against the staged master before packing (the LAB-14 gate): self-IoU 0.993 against a runner-up of 0.748. She sits on a coil, so the feet rule resolves to the COIL BASE (the Vritra reading). Native exit, so the Naga dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised. A SOFT CAST on the Shesha evidence: her picture change never exceeds 2.9 across the whole performance and her brightness peaks at 8.9k, an order below Shesha. Nothing strikes - she conjures a droplet, then an orb with a flat green ring spinning above her palm - so the nova rides that ring at its fullest (f076) and contactStrength halves the flash with no impulse. THE FIRST CARD BELOW 384: her box is COMPACT (hood-tall, never frame-wide) and a small box forces a LARGER scale, so every cell is denser - box compactness drives atlas cost, not character size. At 384 she would put 12.3 MB on the 256 rung, the highest in the lab; at 320 she costs 8.1 MB. Stopped at f110 with the fade tail over f101-f110: her residue is the Kartikeya pink class, creeping into her dissolving torso from f106, and the ramp covers that decay rather than the good frames. Engine power P7, no balance renumbering

kulika.name: Kulika
kulika.label: Kulika (Naga Hero, Legendary)
kulika.ruling: LAB-15 - a Wave-1 NAGA hero. Identity re-verified against the staged master before packing (the LAB-14 gate): self-IoU 0.988 against a runner-up of 0.757. She sits on a coil, so the feet rule resolves to the COIL BASE (the Vritra reading). Native exit, so the Naga dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised. HER BURST IS ALSO HER EXIT: she conjures a green orb, it collapses to a wisp, and her coil ignites into black specks and green fire. So ACT opens at f070 where the orb collapses - the action beginning to resolve - and the nova lands mid-ACT on f087, the ignition the fine scan pinned (green 7.7k at f085 to 11.4k to 27.6k at f087, a 2.4x jump with the largest picture change in the clip to that point). Stopped at f104 with the fade tail over f095-f104: her residue reads as a pale grey cloud rather than pink, but it dominates from f099 as the green fades, so the ramp covers it while the burst plays at full alpha. Engine power P8, no balance renumbering

sugriva.name: Sugriva
sugriva.label: Sugriva (Vanara Hero, Epic)
sugriva.ruling: LAB-16 - one of the first VANARA actors since the pilot wave. Identity re-verified against the staged master before packing: self-IoU 0.985 against a runner-up of 0.611. He stands, so the ordinary feet rule sets the pivot on the settled frame f000. Native exit, so the Vanara dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised - all three faction presets now are. His dissolve is TAN-GOLD DUST, the blind spot of the source ground-share metric (tan has B < G, so no source pixel is ground-dominant): the trim was set on the OUTPUT pink cast as well, which M34 now requires jointly with the source metric. He strikes TWICE - a horizontal staff sweep that flings dark fragments right, then a vertical slam with a burst at his feet - and the nova rides the SLAM (f056): brightness jumps 29.6k to 47.9k with the largest picture change in his act, while the sweep climbs smoothly with no clean onset to put a contact on. THE FIRST ON-PLAY ABILITY THAT FIRES ON AN EMPTY BOARD: his draw runs (hand 10 to 10, deck 2 to 1) yet is invisible to both the event stream and the board difference, so his fixture guard rail asserts the draw explicitly rather than letting it pass silently. Stopped at f110: the output pink cast breaks from 14 percent to 20.0 at f108 and 28.5 at f110. Bottom feather 16 px against a 24 px core gap across all 52 EMERGE frames. Engine power P6, no balance renumbering

angad.name: Angad
angad.label: Angad (Vanara Hero, Epic)
angad.ruling: LAB-16 - one of the first VANARA actors since the pilot wave. Identity re-verified against the staged master before packing: self-IoU 0.973 against a runner-up of 0.597. He stands, so the ordinary feet rule sets the pivot on the settled frame f000. Native exit, so the Vanara dissolve preset stays untuned and unexercised - all three faction presets now are. His dissolve is TAN-GOLD DUST, the blind spot of the source ground-share metric (tan has B < G, so no source pixel is ground-dominant): the trim was set on the OUTPUT pink cast as well, which M34 now requires jointly with the source metric. The busiest clip in the lab. He does not spin his shield - he RAISES it and it throws a white radial flash, born on f053 (brightness 32.3k to 70.4k, the largest picture change in the clip at f055), a defensive ward that suits a card whose opponent forfeits a turn for playing an Astra. He crouches wide, feet 579 px apart. NO BOTTOM FEATHER, and none is possible: his core touches the bottom edge at f039 during the dust-kick lunge, so the all-frames guard can never pass a band, and he touches that edge in 87 frames, the most in the lab - an accepted cut, the Garuda precedent. Stopped at f104: clean through f094, a pink rim from f096, and a break into pink fragments at f104 where the output pink cast jumps from 19.2 to 37.3 percent. Engine power P7, no balance renumbering

anjana.name: Anjana
anjana.label: Anjana (Vanara Hero, Legendary)
anjana.ruling: LAB-17 - a Wave-1 VANARA hero, reached by NAME through the scenario deck, no shim. Identity re-verified against her staged master: self-IoU 0.987 against a runner-up of 0.633. A SOFT CAST: her picture change holds at about 4 through the whole ribbon with no percussive frame anywhere, so the nova rides the ribbon at its fullest (f085, 79.3k) - five frames before the gold glow at her feet ignites at f090, which is her exit rather than her act - and contactStrength halves the flash with no impulse. THE FIRST CARD THAT TOUCHES NO FRAME EDGE in any frame, so she carries no feather at all. Stopped at f105: her residue is the SOURCE class (source share crosses 20 percent at f102 while output pink stays at or under 17), and the trim costs her genuine teal sari fragments at f110-f120, which read 36-51 percent ground - real content excluded because contamination rides it, the Bali stone-chunk precedent. Her passive only raises the Leap limit, and no Leap happens in a fixture: inert. Engine power P6, no balance renumbering

makardhwaja.name: Makardhwaja
makardhwaja.label: Makardhwaja (Vanara Hero, Legendary)
makardhwaja.ruling: LAB-17 - a Wave-1 VANARA hero, reached by NAME through the scenario deck, no shim. Identity re-verified: self-IoU 0.929 - the lowest in the batch - but a margin of 0.441 over the runner-up, the WIDEST of any card, because his lunge is unlike anyone else. THE FIRST GROUND-IMPACT CARD SINCE BALI, inheriting both of his conditions. His search window is (56, 70): unwindowed the rule fires at f040 while he is AIRBORNE, where his tail sweeps low through the ground band, and his wide lunge leaves only one foot within 14 px of the ground line so the feet exclusion covers 16 percent of the width; windowed, it fires on f059 where the landing splash first reaches the band. And ground-impact is not nova, so travelScale 0 is stated explicitly - the LAB-13a trap, named and avoided. His core rides the TOP edge for 24 airborne frames (f039-f062), an accepted cut per Garuda; he never touches the bottom. CELLPX 352, not the 320 ruled: at 320 his 256 rung packs to 25.532 percent of the 512 rung and fails the M21 quarter-rung invariant by 35,269 bytes, while 288, 352 and 384 all pass - 352 is the nearest to the ruling, still sub-384, at 8.3 MB. ENGINE VERSUS ROSTER: the roster calls his ability a Leap from Hanuman; the engine copies the power of Bali (engine id hanuman) or the strongest friendly Unit, directly and not through a Leap - the engine is authoritative. On the empty fixture board his NO-SOURCE branch runs and leaves its trace only in the log, which his guard rail asserts: the mirror of Sugriva, whose draw changed state and left no log. Engine power P7, no balance renumbering

rahu.name: Rahu
rahu.label: Rahu (Asura Hero, Epic)
rahu.ruling: LAB-18 - the LAST card of the roster, a launch ASURA hero: a severed floating head, black smoke matter, on the batch's one GREEN key (single channel, G, after nine pair keys). Identity re-verified against his staged master: self-IoU 0.974, runner-up 0.601, margin 0.373. THE BRIGHT MATTE: on the three risks the two mattes tie by the numbers (translucent-smoke green cast neutralised, despill neutral on near-black, corona hue preserved), but the dark-body matte gaps his corona at f076 and fringes the smoke red, so the frames decide; rembg is unused (fringe 0.000 percent) - the lab's hardest keying case resolved on the standard path. PIVOT READING FOUR: the ordinary feet rule on f000 lands on his lowest smoke tendril (926.2, 1053), so the smoke is the TETHER on the ground line and the head hangs above it - no knob, the Garuda precedent - and his bottom-up dissolve completes the apparition. KEEP_DUPLICATES: his shimmer moves below the 0.6 duplicate threshold on 29 GENUINE frames (change inside a dropped pair 0.37-0.54 matches between pairs 0.36-0.57), so every frame is kept (93 cells) - recording them as true duplicates would make the manifest false. A SOFT nova ({flash 0.5, impulse 0}) at f044, ACT cell 12, the radiance at its fullest: the most static clip in the lab, gold within 1 percent over a flat glow, so any frame f024-f050 is equivalent and the rule is the tiebreaker. Native exit, fade tail f083-f092, trim f093-f120 (near-black, source ground share crosses 20 percent at f090). The second card touching NO frame edge, after Anjana: no feather. cellPx 384, M21 25.095 percent, 8.9 MB. HIS ABILITY IS INERT BY TIMING: a PASSIVE that discards from the opponent's hand at the start of each round (endRound), never on play, so the guard rail asserts the opponent's hand 10 to 10 and discard 0 to 0. Engine power P4 Epic, no balance renumbering

vajra.name: Vajra
vajra.label: Vajra (Deva Astra, Legendary — strike clip)
vajra.ruling: LAB-19 - THE PREMIUM EFFECTS TRACK OPENS. Not an actor: A2 stands (an Astra plays its effect, nothing emerges) and the owner amendment admits ADDITIVE EFFECT CLIPS for Mythic/Legendary Astras, Mantras and Artifacts - black-ground emissive Kling footage played additively, with no actor-class assets (no matte, no rungs, no per-actor memory ladder) - and carves out of v4a that an Astra's effect may depict its OWN weapon: the weapon is the spell. The clip is S1, the strike alone (f085-f120, 36 cells at 448), slotted into the live game's Vajra contract: sfx_astra at the cast, the clip started inside the cast beat's hold so its impact cell (f093) lands exactly on the destroy beat (sfx_unit_destroy and the card crack), its aftermath un-awaited - wire-clock cost 0 ms. Anchored on the target card's centre at 2.4 card widths across the ring. Budget E1: 17.7 MB decoded, one clip at a time

brahmastra.name: Brahmastra
brahmastra.label: Brahmastra (Deva Astra, Mythic — the ultimate weapon)
brahmastra.ruling: LAB-21 - THE MYTHIC SHELF CLOSES (1 of 2). Brahmastra is a DESTROY-class board weapon: it destroys ALL enemy Units and overrides every shield and immunity, including Hiranyakashipu, whom isAstraImmune excepts BY NAME. A single clip of the new VIGNETTE class: frame-filling gold mandala detonation whose content crosses every edge in every one of its 40 cells, so it carries an ALL-EDGE vignette (L/R 96, top 48, bottom 64 source px) guarded on the mandala ring body read off the beams - the ring reaches the left band only on f087-f090, inside the fade tail. Portion f051-f090 at 416, impact f075 (cell 24) measured as the biggest escalation step, on the FIRST DESTROY cue at 1443 / 866 ms; wire-clock cost 0. Anchored on the CASTER'S ENEMY HALF CENTRE, the game's own row-plate anchor (sprBrahmastra), scaled so the mandala ring spans 2.0 card widths - the pre-authorized fallback, taken because at the ruled 2.4 cw the enemy half's median luma reads 170 against 68 bare. Its red arm contour PASSES the LAB-20 sticker test (a flame edge: it sits on the bright side of the gradient, dark-gap share 2-8%, band 1.9-4.7 px native against a 5.18x downscale). The f093+ vivid-yellow posterized phase is EXCLUDED - a reshoot candidate; the lost second of plate life returns only with a regenerated ending. Keeps sfx_brahmastra, the game's one bespoke impact file

pashupata.name: Pashupatastra
pashupata.label: Pashupatastra (Asura Astra, Mythic — the first premium effect off the Deva shelf)
pashupata.ruling: LAB-21 - THE MYTHIC SHELF CLOSES (2 of 2), and the FIRST premium effect outside the Deva shelf. Pashupatastra is a DAMAGE-class board weapon (dmgAstra): it deals max(1, floor(your total board power / enemy Units)) to every enemy Unit and fires Chaos Surge; Hiranyakashipu SURVIVES it, floored at 1 with a block event - the mirror of Brahmastra on the same unit. A single clip of the VIGNETTE class, 60 cells f000-f059 at 352 (E1 17.86 MB; 320 was pre-authorized and NOT needed). The S1 pattern: the clip starts AT the beat with a fade-in, so its impact cell f024 is POSITIONAL - the pin's job is alignment, the columns are already landed - on the FIRST DAMAGE cue at 1443 / 866 ms; wire-clock cost 0. This clip is NOT a continuous escalation: its added light is flat (33 to 43 to 36), which is why no escalation step is pinned. Anchored on the CASTER'S ENEMY HALF CENTRE (sprPashupatastra), scaled so the vortex spans 4.1 card widths = the full half width: 2.4 cw is the shelf's DEFAULT, not a law (owner ruling LAB-21/3) - at full width this clip blows out only 6.0% of the enemy half against Brahmastra's 31.6%, because it is a dark-ground vortex, not a flood. Vignette L 96 / R 128 / B 96 and a TOKEN top band of 12 px: the vortex rim runs within 16 px of the top edge at f026, so a real top band would scissor it. THAT IS A POSITIONAL DEPENDENCY - it is accepted only because the plate's top edge sits flush with the half boundary, where the hard cut is hidden by the board's own edge, and must be RE-RULED if the anchor or scale ever changes. The f079+ beaded-void phase is EXCLUDED - a reshoot candidate

sudarshana.name: Sudarshana Chakra
sudarshana.label: Sudarshana Chakra (Deva Astra, Mythic — invoke + strike chain)
sudarshana.ruling: LAB-20 - THE FIRST CHAINED EFFECT, on the premium effects track (Mythic Astra). Sudarshana Chakra is a REMOVAL, not a kill: the engine removes one enemy Hero for the round (play, then passive Sudarshana removed), and the game's own contract throws a disc from the caster's half centre, bites the Hero after a 380 ms flight, and lifts the Hero away cleanly. Two clips: an INVOCATION (f083-f098, 16 cells at 448, 7.9 MB) on the caster's half centre, disc about 2.0 card widths, handed off at 908 ms to a STRIKE (f034-f088, 55 cells at 288, 14.0 MB, 92 percent of native) whose ring-snap f053 lands on the bite at both speeds - wire-clock cost 0 ms. E1 unchanged: decoded one after the other, the invocation released at the handoff before the strike decodes. The disc arrives from the board's horizontal centre (horizontal mirror only). The impact pin draws the impact cell on the bite's frame. No target: nothing plays. The f090+ red-contour burst is excluded, a reshoot candidate
